name: modern-opentofu-best-practices
description: Professional modern OpenTofu engineering best practices covering modular architecture & registry distribution, native state and plan encryption (AES-GCM / PBKDF2 / KMS), early variable evaluation & dynamic providers, remote backends & state locking, shift-left testing with native 'tofu test' (provider mocking, resource overrides, assertions), TFLint & Trivy security quality gates, passwordless OIDC CI/CD GitOps pipelines, resource lifecycle controls (prevent_destroy, moved, removed, import), and living README.md runbook documentation.
